lastCompletedStory.title: Pin bun and Node versions with a shared toolchain reader

nextStoryContext: US-001 added .bun-version (pinned '1.3.13', single line, exact semver, no prefix) and .tool-versions (pinned 'nodejs 22.23.1', asdf format) at repo root, plus src/config/toolchain.ts exporting readPinnedBunVersion(path?, readFileFn?) and readPinnedNodeVersion(path?, readFileFn?). Both readers: injectable ReadFileFn seam (defaults to node:fs readFileSync), trim whitespace, validate exact semver shape via regex, return null on any error/malformed content (never throw), no fs access at import time (matches src/config/permission-mode.ts and src/config/models.ts conventions in this repo). US-002 (check-ci-parity) should import readPinnedBunVersion/readPinnedNodeVersion from src/config/toolchain.ts and assert ci.yml's setup-bun bun-version-file input points at .bun-version (not a hardcoded version string). US-003 (worker Dockerfile toolchain) should read the same two functions to build the Docker build-arg rather than re-parsing the files. Confirmed the locally installed bun is 1.2.23 and the container's is also older than the 1.3.13 pin (this is expected and is the whole point of CAM-201: the pin files are the target state; US-006/007's preflight assert + auto-rebuild are what bring the running container up to the pin, not this story).

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed .tool-versions format is '<tool-name> <exact-version>' per line (no ranges/codenames allowed); our 'nodejs 22.23.1' line and readPinnedNodeVersion's regex match this exactly.
